verdict.rationale: Cline's Plan mode is documented as a read-only exploration mode where it can read the codebase, run searches and discuss strategy, which directly serves understanding a codebase and planning where to make changes. Subagents add parallel research agents that explore the codebase independently and return detailed reports. One community comment criticizes Cline for not indexing the codebase, but that is a design critique, not a documented failure, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: no dedicated architecture/dependency mapping or codebase-overview feature documented, no hands-on or independent corroboration of codebase-comprehension quality, thin depth on how Cline explains how components fit together.

support.subject: As a developer, I can understand how a codebase fits together to find where to start making changes

citations.quote: In this mode, Cline can read your codebase, run searches, and discuss strategy, but cannot modify any files or execute commands.
Plan mode lets you explore and strategize without changing files.
Each subagent gets its own prompt and context window, explores the codebase independently, and returns a detailed report to the main agent.
